_about: The fonts of the English/Arabic localization (2026-11-19). Paths are relative to the project folder. Change a file or size here, then rebuild: dev/psnova/rebuild_l10n.sh text (in-game text), subs (movie subtitles), warning (boot notice) or all. docs/psnova/fonts.md explains each entry.

game_arabic.note: Arabic in menus, dialogue boxes, help: drawn as glyph pictures into each message file (21-px rows)

game_english.note: English letters drawn as glyph pictures instead of the game's own fixed-width letters; null = the game's font. Characters the font lacks keep the game's font.

ui_english.note: labels redrawn into UI textures (.aif): menu banners, button guide, chapter cards, tutorial pictures
